description: Small brown insects that suck plant juices, causing yellowing and stunted growth
prevention: Use resistant varieties, maintain proper water levels, apply neem oil spray

description: Fungal disease causing diamond-shaped lesions on leaves, can destroy entire fields in favorable conditions
prevention: Use resistant varieties, avoid excess nitrogen, apply fungicide at early signs

description: Larvae bore into stems causing the central shoot to dry out (deadheart symptom)
prevention: Remove and destroy affected tillers, use pheromone traps, timely transplanting

description: Small green/black insects that cluster on leaves and stems
prevention: Regular monitoring, use ladybird beetles, spray with soapy water

description: Fungal disease causing yellow-orange stripes of pustules on leaves, spreads rapidly in cool humid weather
prevention: Use resistant varieties, timely fungicide application, avoid late sowing

description: Damage roots and lower stems, especially in dry, sandy soils
prevention: Deep summer ploughing, seed treatment with recommended insecticide, avoid undecomposed manure

description: Caterpillars that bore into cotton bolls, reducing yield significantly
prevention: Use pheromone traps, Bt cotton varieties, biological control agents

description: Sap-sucking insects that also transmit viral diseases like leaf curl virus
prevention: Yellow sticky traps, neem-based sprays, avoid excess nitrogen fertilizer

description: Larvae feed inside bolls, making detection difficult until damage is done
prevention: Pheromone traps, destroy crop residue after harvest, timely sowing

description: Fungal disease causing red discoloration and hollow stems
prevention: Use disease-free seeds, proper drainage, crop rotation

description: Larvae bore into young shoots causing deadheart symptom in early growth stage
prevention: Remove and destroy affected shoots, use pheromone traps, timely planting

description: Sap-sucking pest that reduces plant vigor and sugar content over time
prevention: Remove lower dry leaves, encourage natural predators, neem oil spray

description: Caterpillars that feed on leaves, causing significant damage to young plants
prevention: Early detection, use of pheromone traps, biological pesticides

description: Larvae tunnel through stems, weakening plants and reducing grain fill
prevention: Destroy crop residue, use resistant varieties, timely sowing

description: Fungal disease causing stunted, chlorotic growth and poor cob development
prevention: Use disease-free seeds, seed treatment with fungicide, crop rotation

description: Causes green ear disease and substantially reduces grain yield
prevention: Use resistant hybrids, seed treatment, remove infected plants early

description: Larvae damage young seedlings, causing deadheart symptom
prevention: Timely sowing, seed treatment, remove and destroy affected seedlings

description: Damages young seedlings similarly to its effect on bajra, reducing plant stand
prevention: Timely sowing with onset of monsoon, seed treatment, resistant varieties

description: Larvae bore into stems causing deadheart and reduced grain yield
prevention: Destroy stubble after harvest, use resistant varieties, timely sowing

description: Larvae mine inside leaves, reducing photosynthetic area and yield
prevention: Remove affected leaves, use light traps, neem-based sprays

description: Fungal disease attacking the stem at the soil line, causing sudden wilting
prevention: Seed treatment with fungicide, avoid waterlogging, crop rotation

description: Larvae girdle stems and branches, causing them to wilt and break
prevention: Destroy crop residue, timely sowing, recommended insecticide spray

description: Transmitted by whiteflies, causes yellow mosaic patterns and stunted pods
prevention: Control whitefly vector, use resistant varieties, remove infected plants

description: Dense colonies on shoots and pods cause curling and stunted growth
prevention: Early sowing, yellow sticky traps, neem oil spray at first sign

description: Fungal disease causing white pustules on the underside of leaves
prevention: Use resistant varieties, avoid dense sowing, fungicide spray if needed

description: Fungal disease causing dark water-soaked lesions that can destroy a crop within days in cool, moist weather
prevention: Use certified disease-free seed tubers, preventive fungicide spray, avoid overhead irrigation

description: Sap-sucking pests that also spread viral diseases between plants
prevention: Use virus-free seed tubers, remove volunteer plants, monitor regularly

description: Larvae bore into developing fruits, causing rot and making them unmarketable
prevention: Pheromone traps, remove and destroy damaged fruits, biological control agents

description: Fungal disease causing concentric-ringed spots on older leaves first
prevention: Crop rotation, avoid overhead watering, remove affected leaves promptly

description: Tiny sap-sucking insects that cause silvery streaks on leaves and reduced bulb size
prevention: Blue sticky traps, avoid water stress, neem-based sprays

description: Fungal disease causing purplish lesions that expand and girdle leaves
prevention: Avoid dense planting, ensure good drainage, fungicide spray in humid weather

description: Larvae bore into developing pods, feeding on the seeds inside
prevention: Pheromone traps, bird perches to encourage predation, biological pesticides

description: Fungal disease causing yellowing and wilting, often plant by plant across a field
prevention: Use resistant varieties, crop rotation, avoid late sowing

description: Sap-sucking insects similar to those affecting wheat, generally less damaging to barley
prevention: Regular monitoring, encourage natural predators, soapy water spray if needed

description: Fungal disease causing orange-brown pustules on leaves and stems
prevention: Use resistant varieties, timely sowing, fungicide spray if severe
